sources.story_title: FCC to Begin Review of the Rural Health Care Program

Promoting Telehealth in Rural America, Third Further Notice of Proposed Rulemaking and Order, WC Docket No. 17-310 — circulated for the 6 Aug 2026 open meeting. Source for layers 4 and 5, the Alaska FY2024/FY2025 figures, and the waiver text.
47 U.S.C. 254(h)(1)(A) — Layer 1, the statutory urban/rural comparability duty
47 CFR 54.605 — Layer 2, rural-rate Methods 1-3 and the interstate/intrastate approval split
Rural Health Care Program — Layer 3, applicant workflow and the FY2027 webinars (HCF 5 Aug 2026, Telecom 26 Aug 2026)
